bibl.title: From Damage to Discovery via Virtual Unwrapping Reading the Scroll from En-Gedi.
bibl.seg: William Brent Seales, Clifford Seth Parker, Michael Segal, Emmanuel Tov, Pnina Shor & Yosef Porath, From Damage to Discovery via Virtual Unwrapping Reading the Scroll from En-Gedi.
bibl.note: Introduction: Virtual unwrapping; - The volumetric scan; - Segmentation; - Texturing; - Flattening; - Merging and visualization. - Results. - Discussion. - Materials and methods: Master view results; - Volumetric scan; - Segmentation; - Texturing; - Flattening; - Merging. - Supplementary materials. - References and notes. - Carbonized parchment scroll [written in Hebrew] found in 1970 in the excavation of a synagogue at En-Gedi (destroyed ca. 600 CE) and dated to the 2nd to 4th century CE.
